name: AI-assisted reminders app for iOS (on-device models)

mentions.name: AI-assisted reminders app for iOS (on-device models)
mentions.description: This iOS reminders app uses on-device AI models to interpret natural-language requests, such as finding a contact and setting a reminder a few weeks before their birthday to get them a gift. It draws on calendar and contact data, and because the models run locally, no personal data is sent to providers and the app can be cheap.
mentions.problem: Cloud AI reminders require sending personal calendar and contact data to providers and incur provider costs; on-device models keep data local and make the app cheap.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on an AI-assisted reminders app using on device models for iOS.
